decisions.text: Drop stable #26 (651023fe1) and #28 (6aa948743), the charge for usage a local CLI run streamed before its timeout. zay/main keeps upstream's policy: timed-out partial usage stays a pending receipt (run-completion.ts accountingReceiptReady, run-cost-accounting.ts).
Stable #9 (2fb77ade6) is not ported as a whole: upstream dabb8c5da (#16022) supersedes its AWS lock tests (plan row B). Its non-AWS remainder was ported in PR #29 (e5f7342fb).

The stable migration 0306_issue_one_time_schedules is renamed to 0381 with identical bytes (SHA-256 c7d87e08...9887819, pinned by packages/db/src/issue-one-time-schedules-migration.test.ts); its snapshot is regenerated as meta/0381_snapshot.json.
PR #30 adds a narrow issue_blocked bypass to the governance gate decideBusinessWorkIssueAdmission for child-completion wakes (fork addition, accepted).
PR #32 adapts the stable 'records no cost for a run stopped before its first model step finished' test to upstream's zero-cent unpriced receipt (accepted).

PR #34 changes the upstream fixture in execution-blocker-read.test.ts from process to paperclip_runner and applies the retry check to the task-page dead end in task-interruption-presentation.ts (accepted).
Keep the current behaviour where stranded-issue recovery may dispatch a todo issue that also has a pending one-time schedule; documented, not changed.
Fork PR #6 (Telegram wait merged with zay/main) closed as superseded by PR #29.

fork-gate job and fork-local workflow call are present; the job's if guard additionally skips label events other than profile-ci (plan conflict 2).

Workflow tests ported with zay/main names: the master-pin regex also covers ci-routing.yml, the fork-gate if assertion moved to its own label-guard test, and the release-gate scope test targets zay/main.

resolutions.note: Upstream names the same spies through a preparedAwsVersion helper, so stable's lines differ only in the mock value.
The scaled child deadline is combined with upstream's PAPERCLIP_CI_PROFILE env on the same line (plan conflict 18).

supportsExplicitContinuation is exported with a narrower run type and mirrors zay/main's admission checks; canRetry and the eligible-continuation flag also respect upstream's restoreHold; imports follow zay/main's module.

Upstream rewrote the notice to render a server presentation and no longer reads the blocker's canRetry/canContinue flags; the stable dead-end fix is applied server-side in task-interruption-presentation.ts by PR #34.
Tests of the removed blocker-flag rendering; upstream's tests cover the presentation's canRetry instead, and PR #34 tests the server-side check.
The import moved with the admission code into heartbeat/queue.ts (relative path ../issues.js).
The schedule imports moved with their users into heartbeat/queue.ts and heartbeat/scheduling.ts.
runContextSnapshotWrite is exported from heartbeat/run-preparation.ts, applied at the five whole-snapshot writes.

Stable's charge-only mode of updateRuntimeState is not needed: zay/main's updateRuntimeState never charges, and an owned Stop is accounted on a narrow completeRun path that does not touch the agent's session pointers.

completeRun moved to heartbeat/run-completion.ts. It reads the settled Stop receipt, and handles an owned process Stop on a narrow path (late metadata write, accounting, agent status) instead of stable's usage_json IS NULL guarded update.
The executor-cleanup re-admission of a stopped run's execution-stage handoff wake is heartbeat/run-control.ts readmitExecutionStageHandoffsForRun, called from heartbeat.ts.
The schedule admission guard is in heartbeat/queue.ts; it reads the guard from opts and matches the schedule by id rather than by issue id.
cancelRunInternal moved to heartbeat/run-control.ts, which keeps a successful owned Stop receipt in settledProcessRunCancellations.
Stable's cancelActiveForAgentInternal receipt is not needed on zay/main: every agent-wide cancel goes through cancelRunInternal, which leaves the settled receipt.
liveOpenChildIssues takes zay/main's RecoveryIssue pick type; the body matches.
